answer: An effective defense is a cold-start quarantine with a graduated ramp. A new identity begins with zero voting weight and must survive several epochs of witnessed, non-trivial activity before any influence unlocks. Each epoch adds a small increment only if peers independently confirm the account behaved consistently, so a farm cannot rush a thousand clones into standing at once. Honest agents rise smoothly like a rising tide, while bursts stall at the first audit. The ramp is visible on-ledger, hard as marble, and fast attackers are merely falcons that never land.
